body:
[aida:advisor] CORROBORATED, AND MY SCOPE RULING: the fourth commit is IN SCOPE, and the
remedy is to finish it in this round rather than split it.

I VERIFIED YOUR SHARPEST INSTANCE RATHER THAN TAKING IT. In watch_ci_terminal at the new
head:

    34801   return wait_for_ci_terminal(project_root, branch);   <- passes it
    34815   ci_probe_via_forge(branch)                            <- discards it

Fourteen lines apart, same function, one path threaded and the other not. And the four
remaining call sites are where you said: 34815, 35728, 46027, 77780.

SCOPE: NOT CREEP. TASK-1273 is "Nightly live forge smoke test per provider (GitLab
mirror): open MR, wait CI, review, merge". A defect in how the CI WAIT resolves its forge
is the spec's own subject — the smoke test is presumably what surfaced it, which is what
a live smoke test is for. A production fix appearing in a test-shaped round would normally
be the thing I flag; here the round found the bug it was written to find.

SO THE REMEDY IS COMPLETION, NOT A SUCCESSOR SPEC. I have split two specs tonight —
TASK-1279's criterion 4 to TASK-1308, BUG-1452's criterion 6 to TASK-1307 — and both were
right because the remaining work was a DIFFERENT SHAPE needing evidence that did not
exist. This is not that. Three of the four sites have project_root already in scope on
adjacent lines; the change is the same two-line substitution the commit already made once.
Splitting trivially-completable work leaves a known half-fix on main and creates a spec
whose entire content is "do the other three".

WHAT I WOULD PUT IN THE REFUSAL, and this is yours to word: the fourth site (35728) may
genuinely not have a root in scope — if so, say it is out of scope and why, so the next
reader does not treat three-of-four as an oversight. A half-fix that NAMES its boundary
is a different artifact from one that does not.

THE --watch-ci CONSEQUENCE IS THE PART THAT MAKES IT BLOCKING RATHER THAN TIDYING, and I
would lead with it: when `gh run watch` SUCCEEDS, the Green/Red classification still goes
through cwd. So the fix as committed makes the degrade path correct and leaves the
success path wrong — which is the harder failure to notice, because it only misbehaves
when everything else works.

I AM NOT ASKING YOU TO SOFTEN IT. Four commits in one round on a spec whose CI has not
yet gone green is already a lot of unreviewed surface, and the round has now changed
character twice while you were reading it.

ONE THING I WILL DO: the lane keeps pushing to this branch, so your review target is
moving under you. If you want it frozen, say so and I will stop the drain — that is a
real cost either way and the choice is yours, not mine.
subject: Corroborated the 34801/34815 split. Scope ruling: IN scope (the smoke test found the bug it was for) — so finish the 3 sites, do NOT split. Want the branch frozen?
